xia-chao opened issue #15195:

#14564 made incoming-request headers a child resource, so dropping the request while headers are alive traps. pchikey says that restriction was deliberately relaxed and wants #14564 reverted. #15142 tried the same for outgoing-request.headers.

can we document the policy first: which child relations still trap, whether #14564 should be reverted, and where this is written down?
CC @rvolosatovs @pchickey
